hypotheses.description: GBT pooled H2H delta vs anchor remains positive with expanded action space
hypotheses._note: R0: +1.061, R1: +0.490, R2: +1.302. Moon/loner expand options -- should not hurt pooled performance if models learn when NOT to use them.

hypotheses.description: GBT comparator net_eppd maintains above 2.0 with expanded action space
hypotheses._note: R0: 2.201, R1: 2.114, R2: 2.255. Expanded action space should not degrade single-seat quality.

hypotheses.description: GBT bids (does not pass) at least 40% of the time in comparator
hypotheses._note: Moon/loner add more action options. Models should still bid regularly -- the expanded space should not cause pathological passing. Lowered from 50% to 40% since more options may shift the pass/bid boundary slightly.

hypotheses.description: GBT R3 suit R-squared does not collapse below R0 baseline
hypotheses._note: R0: 0.588, R1: 0.621, R2: 0.603. Moon/loner add complexity to suit predictions. Lowered threshold -- the question is whether models can still predict regular suit outcomes well while also handling moon/loner.

hypotheses.description: Two-stage model gap vs GBT is within 1.0 net_eppd in comparator
hypotheses._note: R0: -0.322, R1: -0.341, R2: gap TBD. Two-stage P(make) must generalize to level-10 moon/loner -- may struggle or may benefit from cleaner P(make)=1 vs 0 signals.

hypotheses.description: All models bid at least half the time
hypotheses._note: Same sanity check as R0-R2. Expanded action space should not cause any model to pass pathologically.

hypotheses.description: GBT H2H win rate vs anchor exceeds 45%
hypotheses._note: R0: 53.2%, R1: 44.0%, R2: 57.2%. Action space expansion should maintain competitive win rate. The anchor cannot bid moon/loner, so R3 models have strictly more options.

hypotheses.description: GBT make rate stays above 50% in comparator
hypotheses._note: Moon and loner require winning ALL 10 tricks. If models bid moon/loner too aggressively, overall make rate will drop. This tests whether models learn selectivity.

hypotheses.description: ModeloEspecifico heuristic is worst among trained models in comparator
hypotheses._note: ModeloEspecifico is a hand-coded heuristic. It may not bid moon/loner at all (or uses fixed rules). Trained models should exploit the expanded action space better.
